Jobs in this route, and the maths they use.

Percentages

Jeweller

Creative and design

\(\displaystyle \dfrac{9}{24} = 0.375\)

How much real gold is in a 9 carat ring?

Gold is measured in carats out of 24. 9 carat gold is 9 parts gold in 24. The UK hallmark writes it as 375: 375 parts gold in every 1000.

  1. \(9 \div 24 = 0.375\), which is 37.5%.
  2. A 9 carat ring weighs 4 g. Gold in it: \(4 \times 0.375 = 1.5\) g.

The answer: \(4 \times 0.375 = 1.5\) g of gold

TV producer

Creative and design

\(\displaystyle \dfrac{8}{60} \times 100\)

How much of a prime-time hour is your programme?

On the main commercial channels, adverts between 6 pm and 11 pm may average no more than 8 minutes an hour. An hour slot at 8 minutes of adverts:

  1. Programme time: \(60 - 8 = 52\) minutes.
  2. Adverts as a share of the hour: \(8 \div 60 \times 100 = 13.3\%\).

The answer: \(60 - 8 = 52\) minutes of programme

Sources

Every job and every figure that is not an example comes from a public page you can check.

  • TV producer: Ofcom, "Code on the Scheduling of Television Advertising"
